Product Description

Experience the inviting aroma of the Yankee Candle Sugared Cinnamon Apple Large Jar Candle, expertly crafted to provide up to 150 hours of consistent, room-filling fragrance. This candle features a premium plant wax blend and a natural-fiber wick, designed for a cleaner burn with less soot and minimal tunneling. Relish the appetizing fragrance of crunchy apple slices layered with sugared cinnamon and vanilla, creating a sweet and spicy ambiance reminiscent of autumn harvests. The formulation contains no added parabens, phthalates, formaldehydes, or sulfates. Developed and tested with decades of expertise, this candle delivers optimal fragrance performance, making it an ideal choice for special occasions or gifting. Enjoy the ultimate in long-lasting scent with every burn and follow standard care recommendations for the best results.

How customer reviews and ratings work

Customer Reviews, including Product Star Ratings help customers to learn more about the product and decide whether it is the right product for them.

To calculate the overall star rating and percentage breakdown by star, we don’t use a simple average. Instead, our system considers things like how recent a review is and if the reviewer bought the item on Amazon. It also analyzed reviews to verify trustworthiness.

Amazon Customer
2 out of 5 stars
New product with terrible quality
Sadly, like everyone else, Yankee Candle decided to cheap out and churn out a garbage product while simultaneously raising the price. I've been buying these for years and I love the sugared cinnamon apple. The scent of my old candle will fill two rooms. The new one barely scents the air around it. You can tell just by looking that it's the candle version of "watered down." So disappointed. I know I'll be able to find a better candle brand for the same price or even lower.

    Yankee candle at a reasonable price

    I always jump on and see what fragrances are on sale

    This is a great scent the sugar cinnamon apple sent smells like your cooking in your kitchen for the holiday holidays. It has great burned time. That’s why I always go with the Yankee candle.

    We gift Yankee candle constantly because of the quality, the sweetness of all of the fragrances that they have for their candles we never really have an issue with the wick so I will say the quality has been great with that

    Remember when your candle is almost down to the bottom, you can always put it in a pot of boiling water till it melts and make yourself a few wax melts

    The length of time for burning is always great because I constantly have candles going

    The name speaks for itself

    But the person who lit the candle will let you know that you can never be disappointed with Yankee candle

    Way to go Amazon for your prices
